title: Approve event hub comps
question: Which composition should we build? Overview-led Details + drawer/sheet panels are locked; pick the north-star framing.

options.label: Details overview
options.thesis: Quiet header, two-column Details card, Hosts, read-only Visibility — the resting state.
options.viewport: Tabs guide; Details owns preview + when/where; Edit / Change photo sit in the card footer.
options.risk: Doesn’t show the drawer interaction itself.

options.label: Edit drawer open
options.thesis: Same Details world with the Edit details right drawer as the signature moment.
options.viewport: Overview dimmed under scrim; drawer carries the form and yellow Update event.
options.risk: Resting Details layout is only half-visible behind the panel.

options.label: Registrations panel
options.thesis: Prove the same panel grammar on Registrations — list stage + Guest details drawer.
options.viewport: Glance strip, invite action, guest rows; click opens the right panel.
options.risk: Details overview composition still needs to be inferred from A.
